w: At 10.08 a.m. Swamishri attended a convention of the Lohana Chovisi Mahajan Community.

After returning from the convention Swamishri wished to sanctify the nursing home of Dr. Raiyani. Since Thakorji was taken straight to the residential quarters of Dr. Raiyani, Swamishri asked that Harikrishna Maharaj be brought to the nursing home. When the attendant sadhu brought the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj, Swamishri humorously added, "You should not take Thakorji away. If you take Him away then I will be uncomfortable. However if you keep Thakorji with us then everything will be fine." Swamishri then had Thakorji placed on Dr. Raiyani’s seat and prayed, "May the patients who come here return home cured and happy. May no one remain in misery and pain." Swamishri then showered petals and sanctified the nursing home.

While Swamishri was having lunch an article on the Pushpadolotsav (color festival) was being read from the Swaminarayan Prakash. On hearing that the colored water squeezed by Lord Swaminarayan reached a height of three stories, Swamishri sighed with reverence. Someone then enquired, "Was the pump squirting the colored water so powerful or...?"
Swamishri said, "No. God was powerful. This was God’s divine play." Swamishri’s amazing answer dissolved the doubts of everyone.
In the evening assembly Swamishri was welcomed and honored by the town’s dignitaries. In his blessings Swamishri enlightened the audience,

"... We have to progress in life. We have progressed materially, which is necessary and important. But along with this we should also progress spiritually. The more we become spiritually oriented, the more the materialistic arrangements will provide peace and happiness in life. And if we subtract spirituality then no amount of materialistic arrangements will give us happiness. So spirituality is the foundation. If the foundation is strong then the building will support a number of floors and remain intact in the face of storms.

"Likewise the foundation of life is dharma. It is necessary to live morally with honesty and non-violence. If there is no dharma in a person then he lives in misery. Dharma and culture are our ornaments. By having faith in God and observing God’s moral instructions one experiences peace and happiness in life..."
A veteran devotee came for Swamishri's darshan. Someone said, "His frequency to the mandir has decreased because he has become a grandfather."
Devotee : I come once a week for darshan.
Swamishri : On Sunday!
Devotee : No. Not on Sundays.

Swamishri (in a tone of reproach): You must attend the Sunday assembly without fail. Take your children with you, but if they cry then there is no need to bring them for the present. Because, when he starts crying your mind will not remain focused in the discourse. Don't always keep your mind engaged in your grandchild, otherwise you will have to take another birth. Look after his physical needs and with the aid of spiritual knowledge remain aloof.
Swamishri brought the senior devotee's life-boat back to its true spiritual direction...

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
23 March 2003, Sarangpur
135 female and 25 male devotees and 40 children pilgrimaged by foot from Botad to Sarangpur (11 km). 83 female devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Rojid to Sarangpur (20 km).
24 March 2003, Sarangpur

18 female and 4 male devotees pilgrimaged from Jadila (10 km). 10 women devotees pilgrimaged from Lathidad (10 km). 30 female and 15 male devotees pilgrimaged from Pati (17 km). And 12 kishores cycled from Gadhada (30 km).
25 March 2003, Sarangpur
3 satsangi youths pilgrimaged by foot from Turkha.
29 March 2003, Sarangpur

For Swamishri's good health, 42 kishores performed 5,813 prostrations and 2,380 rosaries all night in the Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir. And 35 kishores performed 4,251 pradakshina and 11,111 rosaries in the mandir.
30 March 2003, Sarangpur
15 devotees had cycled 125 km from Khambhat to Sarangpur. 45 women and kishoris and 10 kishores from Tajpur pilgrimaged by foot to Sarangpur. 45 devotees walked from Barvala to Sarangpur.

At 9.25 a.m. Swamishri arrived for the yagna rituals for the murti-pratishtha of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha Krishna Dev and Guru Parampara for the BAPS Swaminarayan Smruti Mandir in Nadiad. The yagna had 79 yagna-pits with 555 participants. The yagna rituals for murtis for BAPS hari mandirs of South Gujarat, namely, Kolak, Siyada, Udhna, Sachin, Kudiyana and Kadod were also performed by Swamishri. Altogether, Swamishri performed murti-pratishtha rituals of seven BAPS hari mandirs. Finally, he blessed the assembly.
From 4.30 p.m.

THE SHRI HARI JAYANTI CELEBRATION commenced at 8.00 pm. Brahmadarshan Swami explained the principal reasons of Shriji Maharaj’s birth. Thereafter Ghanshyamcharan Swami elaborated upon the glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. A bhajan ‘Premvati sut jãyo anupam’ was sung by sadhus. Then Viveksagar Swami’s address to the assembly was followed by a traditional dance by children and teenagers.

At 9.50 pm Swamishri blessed the festival assembly, “Today is a priceless day for us because God graced us with his birth. He took birth to liberate souls, resolving that aspirants realize his divine form and attain the happiness of his abode. By becoming aksharrup and offering bhakti to Purushottam one becomes free from rebirth. Till one does not realize divine knowledge and glory of God the cycles of life and death prevail. “So, God has blessed us with this priceless human birth. You cannot get a human body even if you amass all the wealth in the world. That is how rare and precious it is. We have received the human body with all parts – hands, legs, eyes, ears, etc. When you give a diamond to someone and he throws it in a trash can, then what benefit has he derived! Similarly, God has given us wonderful eyes to see good things, but what are we seeing instead! We see bad things and hence our eyes become sinful. By having darshan of God and his Sadhu the sins of ones eyes are dissolved. Such is the glory of darshan.”
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti for three BAPS hari mandirs in Raipur (district: Gandhinagar), Nirnaynagar and Chandlodiya (suburbs of Ahmedabad).
PATIENTLY RESOLVING A DEVOTEE’S PROBLEM

31 March 208, Sarangpur Swamishri was reading letters from devotees. Shri Natvarbhai Patel, a devotee of Pannavada village of Sabarkantha district, had sent a note and site maps of his two farms. In his letter he had asked as to where he should bore the ground for water. After reading his letter and seeing the site maps Swamishri thought for some time. Before he could decide he was interrupted with a request to sanctify the newly built residential accommodations for devotees on the mandir precincts. Swamishri placed the letter aside to sanctify the buildings. On returning, Swamishri took the same letter in hand and read it again. Then Swamishri once again looked at the site map. The devotee had informed that the water level beneath one of his farm lands was nearly exhausted. He was drawing water from a common well on his second farm which was adjacent to his first one. Swamishri replied, “Since there is no water in his first farm, he should bore the ground around the common well (in his second farm).” To resolve this seemingly minor problem, Swamishri patiently spent twenty minutes.

ds.t: Akshardham in the blink of an eye
w: The sadhus who spread satsang abroad on Swamishri's command were to leave Sarangpur in a day or two. Today these sadhus came for Swamishri's blessings. During a light conversation, Swamishri told all the sadhus, "Now you can sit in a plane and reach America just like that."
Vivekmurti Swami said, "How many hours would it take to go to Akshardham?"
As if snapping his fingers, Swamishri said, "No time at all. Just like this, you are there in the blink of an eye."
Only the Gunatit Satpurush, for whom Akshardham is not even an atom's distance away, could make the journey to Akshardham so fast!

ds.t: A fifteen year old turns back
w: A fifteen year old boy came from Mumbai for darshan. At just fifteen, through bad company, he had become a thug. Along with it, many kinds of addiction, even opium, had crept in. This boy, who had barely reached tenth grade, had realised he was sinking deeper and deeper down the wrong path, and so he had come to Swamishri to take an atonement and reform.

He said to Swamishri, "At first it was great fun showing off with friends, but then I had to bring money to use drugs and to get others to use them. I had to make deals with those who brought opium, and that frightened me, so to try to turn back I began to stop going with such friends. But now the friends themselves pressure me, demand money and make me use drugs even when I do not want to. If you are kind, I can get out of this. Please give me some atonement."

Hearing this, Swamishri was left speechless. What could he say to such a young boy? But Swamishri said, "Remember God, and never even by mistake fall into such company. Pay attention to your studies and avoid going with such friends."

st.t: Earth Hour 2021 at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi
w: Supporting Earth Hour, Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi joined the global community and participated on March 27, 2021 in the annual movement to show support for our planet. By switching off all non-essential lights for one hour from 8:30 to 9:30 pm, Swaminarayan Akshardham continued its support for environmental conservation.

Around the world, Earth Hour is embraced by the global community, transcending race, culture, age and economics as individuals take leadership in their communities in the pursuit of a cleaner and safer planet. The purpose of celebrating ‘The Earth Hour’ is to save electrical power, and to take a stand against climate change in order to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and build a future where people live in harmony by reducing light pollution and carbon footprint.
